# Harsh Pratap Singh

> Personal blog about Engineering, Research, and building things.

## About

Harsh Pratap Singh is a software engineer and researcher focused on Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, Databases, and Cryptography. This site contains technical writeups, reading lists, and a resume.

## Site Structure

- `/` - Home page with bio and links
- `/writes/` - Technical blog posts about engineering and research
- `/reads/` - Curated reading lists for CS, Philosophy, Startups, and Finance
- `/resume/` - Professional experience and work history
